confirmed_mismatch.description: Generated Java returned an attempted journal stamp on failure paths, whereas the COBOL reference initialized the response and assigned the journal stamp only on successful completion.
confirmed_mismatch.correction: Separated internal journal stamp from response journal stamp and assigned the response stamp only after successful journal write.

limitations: Validation covers 16 defined scenarios, not all possible executions.
BUSINESS_RULE is a composite validation dimension.
S12 retains the reference behavior of an unsuccessful rollback, which can leave an unjournaled debit.
